questions.question_english: Teacher Appraisal in government schools is primarily formally documented through the:
options_english: Minutes recorded during monthly administrative staff meetings
The official register maintained by the School Management Committee
The formal Annual Confidential Report (ACR) or APAR dossier
Daily attendance registers maintained for student enrollment tracking
questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is (c). In government schools and public administrative systems across India, the comprehensive annual appraisal of teachers and educational administrators is formally documented through the Annual Confidential Report (ACR) or its contemporary standardized equivalent, the Annual Performance Assessment Report (APAR). This statutory dossier systematically records an educator's pedagogical performance, student academic outcomes, professional integrity, administrative diligence, punctuality, and areas needing development. The ACR/APAR serves as the official legal and institutional foundation for career progression, promotions, selection grade awards, and administrative deployments. Options (a), (b), and (d) represent routine operational administrative records (meeting minutes, SMC registers, and daily attendance logs) rather than formal personnel evaluation instruments.

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Formal teacher appraisal in government educational institutions is officially documented through the Annual Confidential Report (ACR) or Annual Performance Assessment Report (APAR). This statutory record documents yearly performance, professional competencies, integrity, administrative compliance, and areas for improvement. The dossier serves as an official evaluation base for career progression, promotions, and administrative personnel decisions.

questions.question_english: A school Principal who operates under the administrative assumptions of McGregor’s ‘Theory Y’ is most likely to:
options_english: Install extensive surveillance cameras inside classrooms to continuously monitor teacher movements and instructional delivery
Systematically withhold critical institutional information from teaching staff in order to preserve centralized administrative power
Use explicit threats of adverse Annual Confidential Report entries as the chief mechanism to enforce staff punctuality
Delegate responsibility and encourage teachers to take initiative
questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is (d). McGregor’s Theory Y assumes that employees view work as natural, possess intrinsic motivation, seek professional responsibility, and exercise ingenuity and self-direction when properly supported. A school principal embracing Theory Y trusts the capabilities and dedication of teachers. Rather than relying on coercive controls or authoritarian oversight, such a leader delegates meaningful administrative and pedagogical authority, encourages teachers to design novel instructional strategies, and fosters collaborative decision-making. In contrast, Options (a), (b), and (c) embody Theory X practices, relying on continuous surveillance, information hoarding, and coercive threats of punitive appraisal ratings.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (d) है। मैकग्रेगर का सिद्धांत Y यह मानता है कि कर्मचारी स्वाभाविक रूप से कार्य को अपनी पहचान का हिस्सा मानते हैं, आत्म-निर्देशन में सक्षम होते हैं, नवाचार करना पसंद करते हैं तथा उत्तरदायित्व स्वीकार करने के लिए तैयार रहते हैं। सिद्धांत Y पर विश्वास करने वाला प्रधानाचार्य शिक्षकों की योग्यता और निष्ठा पर भरोसा करता है। वह शिक्षकों को निर्णय लेने की स्वतंत्रता और अधिकार सौंपता है (प्रत्यायोजन करता है), तथा उन्हें नए शैक्षणिक प्रयोगों और संस्थागत सुधारों में स्वैच्छिक पहल करने के लिए प्रेरित करता है। इसके विपरीत, विकल्प (a) कक्षाओं में कैमरों से निगरानी करना, विकल्प (b) प्रशासनिक सत्ता के लिए सूचनाएँ छिपाना तथा विकल्प (c) प्रतिकूल ACR की धमकियाँ देना—ये सभी सिद्धांत X के दमनकारी, अविश्वासपूर्ण और सत्तावादी तौर-तरीकों का प्रतिनिधित्व करते हैं।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (D) Delegate responsibility and encourage teachers to take initiative.

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Douglas McGregor’s Theory Y assumes that employees view work as natural, possess self-direction, seek responsibility, and exercise creativity. A school principal adopting Theory Y assumptions trusts teachers’ capabilities, delegates meaningful authority, and fosters open decision-making. Instead of using surveillance or punitive threats, the principal creates a supportive environment that encourages professional initiative and self-motivation.

questions.question_english: In contemporary educational administration, the paradigm shift from traditional 'Inspection' to modern 'Supervision' is most accurately characterized as transitioning from:
options_english: A supportive, collegial supervisory model to an authoritarian, fault-finding bureaucratic regime
An ongoing, formative development process to an annual, highly rigid summative audit
An autocratic, periodic evaluative event to a collaborative, ongoing developmental process
An internal peer-review feedback mechanism to an external statutory compliance audit
questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is (c). The evolution of educational administration reflects a major paradigm shift from traditional 'inspection' to modern 'supervision'. Traditional inspection was characterized by autocratic control, sporadic surprise visits, fault-finding, and enforcing external bureaucratic conformity, often creating fear and defensive attitudes among teachers. In contrast, modern instructional supervision is conceived as a continuous, collaborative, democratic, and developmental process. Its primary aim is to assist teachers in improving pedagogical methods, foster reflective inquiry, and enhance student learning outcomes within a supportive, trusting professional climate. Option (a) describes the exact reverse of the historical shift. Option (b) describes a regressive move from formative to summative evaluation. Option (d) describes an administrative audit rather than instructional supervision.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (c) है। आधुनिक शैक्षिक प्रशासन में 'निरीक्षण' से 'पर्यवेक्षण' की ओर बदलाव शिक्षा दर्शन में एक युगांतकारी परिवर्तन है। पारंपरिक निरीक्षण एक निरंकुश, औचक और केवल कमियाँ या दोष खोजने वाली प्रक्रिया थी, जिससे शिक्षकों में भय का वातावरण बनता था। इसके विपरीत, आधुनिक शैक्षिक पर्यवेक्षण एक सतत, सहयोगात्मक, प्रजातांत्रिक और विकासात्मक प्रक्रिया है। इसका मुख्य उद्देश्य शिक्षकों की शिक्षण पद्धतियों को परिष्कृत करना, उनकी व्यावसायिक क्षमता का संवर्धन करना और एक प्रेरक वातावरण में शिक्षण-अधिगम गुणवत्ता में सुधार करना है। विकल्प (a) उल्टी प्रक्रिया को बताता है। विकल्प (b) रचनात्मक से कठोर योगात्मक की ओर पतन को दर्शाता है। विकल्प (d) केवल प्रशासनिक व वित्तीय ऑडिट को निरूपित करता है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (C) An autocratic, evaluative event to a collaborative, developmental supervisory process.

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Modern educational administration has shifted from traditional inspection to contemporary supervision. Traditional inspection functioned as an autocratic, periodic event aimed at finding faults and enforcing external compliance. In contrast, modern supervision operates as a continuous, collaborative, and developmental process focused on guiding teachers, enhancing instructional practices, providing constructive feedback, and fostering professional growth within a supportive learning environment.

questions.question_english: In institutional management, how does Quality Assurance (QA) fundamentally differ from Quality Control (QC)?
options_english: QA is reactive and focuses on inspecting and eliminating defects after institutional outcomes have failed
QA is proactive and focuses on designing systemic processes to prevent deficiencies from occurring
QA is confined strictly to the retrospective financial auditing of institutional ledger books
QA is executed exclusively through periodic external punitive inspections by governmental authorities
questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is (b). In organizational management, Quality Assurance (QA) and Quality Control (QC) are distinct concepts. Quality Assurance is proactive, process-oriented, and focused on defect prevention. It designs, standardizes, and continually evaluates instructional, curricular, and administrative processes so that failures or deficiencies do not occur in the first place. In contrast, Quality Control (QC) is reactive and product-oriented; it focuses on inspecting finished outcomes (such as grading end-of-year exams or checking finished products) to detect and correct defects after they have occurred. Option (a) is incorrect because being reactive and defect-detecting describes Quality Control, not Quality Assurance. Option (c) is incorrect because QA encompasses holistic academic, instructional, and administrative processes, not merely financial audits. Option (d) is incorrect because QA is predominantly an internal, systemic institutional culture rather than an external punitive inspection.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (b) है। प्रबंधन विज्ञान में गुणवत्ता आश्वासन (QA) और गुणवत्ता नियंत्रण (QC) में स्पष्ट अंतर है। 'गुणवत्ता आश्वासन' (QA) एक अग्रसक्रिय और प्रक्रिया-उन्मुख दृष्टिकोण है जिसका मुख्य उद्देश्य ऐसी सुदृढ़ प्रणालियाँ और मानक विकसित करना है जिससे गलतियाँ या कमियाँ उत्पन्न ही न हों। इसके विपरीत, 'गुणवत्ता नियंत्रण' (QC) एक प्रतिक्रियात्मक और उत्पाद-उन्मुख दृष्टिकोण है जो कार्य पूरा होने के बाद अंतिम परिणाम का निरीक्षण कर कमियों को खोजता है। विकल्प (a) गलत है क्योंकि यह गुणवत्ता नियंत्रण की विशेषता है। विकल्प (c) गलत है क्योंकि QA केवल वित्तीय अंकेक्षण तक सीमित नहीं है, बल्कि संपूर्ण शैक्षणिक प्रक्रिया को समाहित करता है। विकल्प (d) गलत है क्योंकि QA संस्था का आंतरिक और सतत प्रयास होता है, केवल बाह्य निरीक्षण नहीं।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (B) Proactive and focused on preventing defects through systemic processes.

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Quality Assurance in educational management operates as a proactive, process-oriented mechanism focused on preventing operational deficiencies before they occur. It establishes standardized operational procedures, continuous evaluation, and systematic workflows to ensure ongoing compliance. In contrast, Quality Control functions reactively by identifying defects in end products, making Quality Assurance essential for building systemic institutional quality.

questions.question_english: The 'Hawthorne Effect', identified during the seminal organizational management experiments led by Elton Mayo, demonstrated that:
options_english: Direct monetary wage incentives serve as the sole reliable administrative mechanism to elevate worker productivity
Maintaining a rigid hierarchical organizational framework invariably triggers steep declines in operational efficiency
Physical environmental variables such as lighting and ambient temperature mathematically dictate worker output rates
Employee productivity increases when workers perceive that they are being observed, valued, and given psychological attention
questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is (d). The 'Hawthorne Effect' originated from the Hawthorne Studies (1924–1932) conducted at the Western Electric Hawthorne Works by Elton Mayo, Fritz Roethlisberger, and colleagues. Initially seeking to measure the impact of physical illumination on productivity, the researchers found that workers' output increased regardless of whether lighting was increased or decreased. The crucial discovery was that productivity rose because employees felt recognized, observed, and valued as significant participants by management. This marked the inception of the Human Relations School of Management, establishing that social dynamics, informal group norms, and psychological recognition outweigh purely physical or mechanical working conditions. Option (a) reflects Taylor's Scientific Management. Option (c) was the disproven initial hypothesis. Option (b) is an unsupported generalization.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (d) है। 'हॉथॉर्न प्रभाव' (Hawthorne Effect) की खोज 1920 और 1930 के दशक में वेस्टर्न इलेक्ट्रिक कंपनी के हॉथॉर्न वर्क्स में एल्टन मेयो और उनके साथियों द्वारा किए गए प्रयोगों से हुई। शोधकर्ताओं ने पाया कि जब श्रमिकों पर विशेष ध्यान दिया गया, उनसे पूछताछ की गई और उन्हें यह महसूस कराया गया कि वे महत्वपूर्ण हैं, तो रोशनी कम करने पर भी उनका उत्पादन बढ़ गया। इसने साबित किया कि भौतिक परिस्थितियों या केवल वित्तीय प्रोत्साहनों की तुलना में सामाजिक कारक, मनोवैज्ञानिक पहचान और प्रबंधन द्वारा दिया गया सम्मान कर्मचारियों की कार्यक्षमता और अभिप्रेरणा को अधिक प्रभावित करते हैं। इसने 'मानव संबंध दृष्टिकोण' (Human Relations Approach) को जन्म दिया। विकल्प (a) टेलर के वैज्ञानिक प्रबंधन से जुड़ा है। विकल्प (c) वह परिकल्पना थी जो प्रयोगों में गलत साबित हुई।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (D) Worker productivity increases when employees feel observed and valued.

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: The Hawthorne Effect, identified during organizational management studies, demonstrates that employees modify their behavior and increase productivity when they know they are being observed and given attention. The findings highlighted that social factors, psychological recognition, and feeling valued by management significantly influence worker performance beyond physical working conditions or financial incentives alone.

questions.explanation_english:
The concept of 'Servant Leadership' was introduced by Robert K. Greenleaf in his seminal 1970 essay, 'The Servant as Leader.' Greenleaf argued that true leadership begins with the natural feeling that one wants to serve first. A servant leader places the needs of followers, employees, and the community ahead of their own personal ambitions or executive authority. Key characteristics of servant leadership include active listening, empathy, healing, self-awareness, persuasion rather than coercion, stewardship, and a deep commitment to the growth and empowerment of individuals.
- Option B is incorrect because 'Authority-Compliance Management' (Blake and Mouton 9,1 style) prioritizes task completion and production while largely treating human needs as secondary.
- Option C is incorrect because 'Authentic Leadership' focuses on self-awareness, relational transparency, internalized moral perspective, and balanced processing rather than Greenleaf's specific servant-first premise.
- Option D is incorrect because 'Trait Theory' suggests that leaders possess inherent, universal physical or psychological traits that differentiate them from non-leaders.
questions.explanation_hindi:
'सेवक नेतृत्व' (सर्वेंट लीडरशिप) की अवधारणा को 1970 में रॉबर्ट के. ग्रीनलीफ ने अपने प्रसिद्ध निबंध में प्रतिपादित किया था। ग्रीनलीफ के अनुसार, उत्कृष्ट नेतृत्व की शुरुआत इस स्वाभाविक भावना से होती है कि व्यक्ति सबसे पहले दूसरों की सेवा करना चाहता है। एक सेवक नेता अपने व्यक्तिगत पद, शक्ति या सत्ता की तुलना में अपने अनुयायियों, शिक्षकों और विद्यार्थियों के कल्याण और विकास को सर्वोपरि रखता है। इसके प्रमुख लक्षणों में सक्रिय श्रवण, सहानुभूति, जागरूकता, प्रत्ययकारी संवाद, संरक्षण और लोगों के संवर्धन के प्रति निष्ठा शामिल हैं।

questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is (c). questions.question_english: Which component of Transactional Leadership involves the leader intervening only when standards are not met or when something goes wrong?

Active Management by Exception Strategy
Passive Management by Exception
Non-Interventionist Laissez-faire Style
questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is (c). Passive Management by Exception is a component of transactional leadership where a supervisor intervenes only after operational standards are breached or explicit problems occur. Unlike active management by exception, where leaders continuously monitor for errors and enforce standards proactively, passive managers allow routine workflows to proceed without interference until explicit performance failures necessitate corrective administrative intervention. questions.question_english: According to Kurt Lewin’s model, the ‘Unfreezing’ stage primarily involves:

Executing the actual operational, administrative, and structural changes across the functional units of the organization

questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is (a). In Kurt Lewin's Change Management framework, the 'Unfreezing' stage is the crucial diagnostic and preparatory phase. Option (b) describes 'Refreezing', where newly acquired habits are institutionalized into SOPs. Option (c) describes the 'Changing' phase, which involves executing actual operational and structural modifications. Option (d) is a coercive administrative tactic that contradicts Lewin's collaborative planned change principles.

questions.question_english: In an educational institution, a leader implementing 'Democratic Supervision' will primarily ensure that:
options_english: Individual teachers are vested with absolute unilateral discretion over institutional financial budgeting
The Directorate of Education and external inspection authorities are entirely excluded from oversight
No formal observation records, statutory evaluations, or written documentation of teaching are maintained
Supervisory processes are transparent, consultative, professional, and collaborative in orientation
questions.explanation_english:
Democratic supervision is rooted in democratic human relations and collaborative educational leadership. Unlike authoritarian inspection—which relies on fault-finding, surprise visits, and top-down coercion—democratic supervision views instructional improvement as a shared, cooperative venture. The supervisor acts as a facilitator, mentor, and educational guide who engages teachers in reflective dialogue, respects professional pedagogical autonomy, establishes collaborative goals, and provides transparent, constructive feedback to elevate teaching-learning outcomes.
- Option A is incorrect because democratic supervision involves collaborative academic decision-making, not abdicating institutional financial governance and capital budgeting to individual teachers.
- Option B is incorrect because school operations must remain accountable to statutory state educational authorities and curriculum frameworks.
- Option C is incorrect because democratic supervision relies on systematic, documented feedback, developmental rubrics, and portfolio records rather than undocumented informality.
questions.explanation_hindi:
लोकतांत्रिक पर्यवेक्षण सहभागी प्रबंधन और मानवीय संबंधों के सिद्धांतों पर आधारित है। पारंपरिक निरंकुश निरीक्षण के विपरीत—जहाँ केवल गलतियाँ ढूंढने, औचक छापों और दंडात्मक कार्रवाइयों पर बल दिया जाता था—लोकतांत्रिक पर्यवेक्षण में पर्यवेक्षक एक मार्गदर्शक, सुगमकर्ता और सहयोगी के रूप में कार्य करता है। इसमें शिक्षकों के साथ सहयोगात्मक पेशेवर संवाद स्थापित किया जाता है, उनकी शैक्षणिक स्वायत्तता का सम्मान किया जाता है और पारदर्शी तथा रचनात्मक प्रतिपुष्टि के माध्यम से शिक्षण-अधिगम वातावरण को समृद्ध बनाया जाता है।
- विकल्प (A) गलत है क्योंकि लोकतांत्रिक पर्यवेक्षण शैक्षणिक सहभागिता को बढ़ावा देता है, यह वित्तीय बजट के प्रशासनिक दायित्वों का परित्याग करना नहीं है।
- विकल्प (B) गलत है क्योंकि विद्यालय राज्य शिक्षा निदेशालय के नियमों और वैधानिक निरीक्षण व्यवस्था के प्रति सदैव उत्तरदायी रहता है।
- विकल्प (C) गलत है क्योंकि लोकतांत्रिक व्यवस्था में भी संरचित अभिलेखीकरण और लिखित रचनात्मक मूल्यांकन अनिवार्य होता है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (D) Making supervision transparent, participatory, and collaborative.

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: An educational leader practicing Democratic Supervision ensures that supervisory processes are transparent, participatory, and collaborative. Rather than using surprise checks or punitive measures, democratic supervisors involve teachers in professional dialogues, establish shared goals, respect pedagogical autonomy, and focus on constructive feedback to enhance instructional quality and foster professional trust across departments.

questions.question_english: Which leadership approach, originally conceptualized by Robert K. Greenleaf, explicitly emphasizes that a leader's primary ethical responsibility is to serve the needs of their followers and prioritize their holistic development?
options_english: Servant Leadership
Authority-Compliance Management
Authentic Leadership
Trait Theory
questions.explanation_english:
The concept of 'Servant Leadership' was introduced by Robert K. Greenleaf in his seminal 1970 essay, 'The Servant as Leader.' Greenleaf argued that true leadership begins with the natural feeling that one wants to serve first. A servant leader places the needs of followers, employees, and the community ahead of their own personal ambitions or executive authority. Key characteristics of servant leadership include active listening, empathy, healing, self-awareness, persuasion rather than coercion, stewardship, and a deep commitment to the growth and empowerment of individuals.
- Option B is incorrect because 'Authority-Compliance Management' (Blake and Mouton 9,1 style) prioritizes task completion and production while largely treating human needs as secondary.
- Option C is incorrect because 'Authentic Leadership' focuses on self-awareness, relational transparency, internalized moral perspective, and balanced processing rather than Greenleaf's specific servant-first premise.
- Option D is incorrect because 'Trait Theory' suggests that leaders possess inherent, universal physical or psychological traits that differentiate them from non-leaders.
questions.explanation_hindi:
'सेवक नेतृत्व' (सर्वेंट लीडरशिप) की अवधारणा को 1970 में रॉबर्ट के. ग्रीनलीफ ने अपने प्रसिद्ध निबंध में प्रतिपादित किया था। ग्रीनलीफ के अनुसार, उत्कृष्ट नेतृत्व की शुरुआत इस स्वाभाविक भावना से होती है कि व्यक्ति सबसे पहले दूसरों की सेवा करना चाहता है। एक सेवक नेता अपने व्यक्तिगत पद, शक्ति या सत्ता की तुलना में अपने अनुयायियों, शिक्षकों और विद्यार्थियों के कल्याण और विकास को सर्वोपरि रखता है। इसके प्रमुख लक्षणों में सक्रिय श्रवण, सहानुभूति, जागरूकता, प्रत्ययकारी संवाद, संरक्षण और लोगों के संवर्धन के प्रति निष्ठा शामिल हैं।
- विकल्प (B) गलत है क्योंकि 'अधिकार-अनुपालन प्रबंधन' में कार्य और उत्पादन पर पूरा जोर दिया जाता है तथा मानवीय आवश्यकताओं की उपेक्षा की जाती है।
- विकल्प (C) गलत है क्योंकि 'प्रामाणिक नेतृत्व' आत्म-जागरूकता, नैतिक दृष्टिकोण और पारदर्शी संबंधों पर केंद्रित होता है, न कि ग्रीनलीफ के सेवा-प्रथम सिद्धांत पर।
- विकल्प (D) गलत है क्योंकि 'विशेषक सिद्धांत' यह मानता है कि नेताओं में जन्मजात शारीरिक और मनोवैज्ञानिक गुण होते हैं जो उन्हें दूसरों से अलग करते हैं।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) Servant Leadership

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Servant Leadership, conceptualized by Robert K. Greenleaf, prioritizes serving the needs of followers and supporting their growth above personal executive authority. A servant leader focuses on empowering staff, demonstrating empathy, listening actively, and building community within the organization. By placing follower development at the center, this approach fosters high trust, collaboration, and collective institutional effectiveness.

questions.question_english: Under standard administrative and financial rules applicable to educational institutions, what is the vital function of a 'Stock Register' (or Accession Register in a school library)?
options_english: Tracking, analyzing, and documenting long-term student classroom attendance trends
Formally recording statutory disciplinary proceedings and penalties initiated against teaching staff
Maintaining official minutes and resolution logs of all School Management Committee meetings
Systematically recording the receipt, issuance, and verified balance of all institutional material assets
questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is (d). Under General Financial Rules (GFR) and educational accounting codes, maintaining a Stock Register (both for consumable items like stationery and non-consumable assets like furniture, lab equipment, and sports goods) and an Accession Register (for library books) is an essential legal and financial mandate. It provides an unalterable chronological audit trail detailing the procurement date, source, cost, inventory voucher, recipient, write-off, and verified physical balance of all institutional assets. This ensures financial accountability, prevents misappropriation, and facilitates statutory annual audits. Option (a) is the function of the Attendance Register. Option (b) is recorded in the Service Book and Confidential Vigilance Dossier. Option (c) is recorded in the SMC Proceedings/Minutes Book.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (d) है। सामान्य वित्तीय नियमों (GFR) और विद्यालयी प्रशासनिक संहिताओं के तहत स्टॉक रजिस्टर (उपभोज्य एवं गैर-उपभोज्य सामग्री पंजिका) तथा पुस्तकालय का एक्सेशन रजिस्टर अत्यंत महत्वपूर्ण वित्तीय अभिलेख होते हैं। इनका उद्देश्य विद्यालय में क्रय की गई प्रत्येक भौतिक वस्तु (फर्नीचर, कंप्यूटर, प्रयोगशाला उपकरण, पुस्तकें आदि) की खरीद, बिल संख्या, प्राप्ति, वितरण (इश्यू) और वर्तमान में उपलब्ध शेष मात्रा का प्रामाणिक लेखा-जोखा रखना है। यह वित्तीय पारदर्शिता सुनिश्चित करता है, परिसंपत्तियों के गबन या नुकसान को रोकता है और वार्षिक ऑडिट में अनिवार्य साक्ष्य प्रस्तुत करता है। विकल्प (a) छात्र उपस्थिति पंजिका से संबंधित है। विकल्प (b) सेवा पुस्तिका और सतर्कता अभिलेखों से संबंधित है। विकल्प (c) SMC कार्यवृत्त पंजिका से संबंधित है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (D) Recording receipt, issue, and balance of all school material assets.

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Under standard financial and administrative regulations, a Stock Register is maintained to record the receipt, issue, maintenance, and available balance of institutional physical assets. It covers durable goods, laboratory equipment, furniture, and consumable materials. Accurate stock accounting ensures transparent resource management, prevents loss or misappropriation, and facilitates mandatory annual auditing processes.

questions.question_english: Democratic Supervision in school administration is characterized by all of the following core practices EXCEPT:
options_english: Establishing participatory and shared decision-making channels between administrative leadership and teaching staff
Sustaining transparent, multi-directional lines of institutional communication across administrative tiers
Demonstrating profound professional respect for teachers' pedagogical autonomy and classroom expertise
Exercising unilateral positional power to enforce strict uniformity in classroom instructional methodologies
questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is (d). Democratic Supervision is grounded in cooperative human relations, mutual respect, shared governance, and high regard for teachers' professional judgment and autonomy. Under democratic supervision, the supervisor functions as a supportive resource person and facilitator rather than an authoritarian boss; teachers are actively involved in curricular decisions and instructional improvements. In contrast, exercising unilateral bureaucratic power to mandate rigid, standardized instructional methods represents Autocratic (Authoritarian) Supervision, which extinguishes teacher initiative, demoralizes staff, and contradicts democratic ideals. Options (a), (b), and (c) are all quintessential characteristics of democratic supervision.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (d) है। प्रजातांत्रिक शैक्षिक पर्यवेक्षण मानवीय संबंधों, आपसी विश्वास, सहयोग और शिक्षकों की व्यावसायिक स्वतंत्रता पर आधारित होता है। इसमें पर्यवेक्षक एक अधिनायक के रूप में आदेश देने के बजाय एक सलाहकार और सहयोगी के रूप में कार्य करता है, जहाँ सभी शिक्षक नीति-निर्माण और शिक्षण सुधार में भाग लेते हैं। अतः एकतरफा सत्ता का प्रयोग कर सभी पर एक जैसी कठोर शिक्षण पद्धतियाँ थोपना निरंकुश (ऑटोक्रैटिक) पर्यवेक्षण का लक्षण है, प्रजातांत्रिक का नहीं। विकल्प (a), (b) और (c) प्रजातांत्रिक पर्यवेक्षण के मूल और सकारात्मक स्तम्भ हैं।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (D) Enforcing strict adherence to positional authority to mandate standard instructional methods.

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: Democratic supervision prioritizes participatory decision-making, mutual respect, open communication, and teacher autonomy. It values the professional expertise of educators and invites collaborative problem-solving across all institutional levels. Enforcing strict adherence to top-down positional authority and mandating rigid instructional methods contradicts democratic principles, as autocratic enforcement eliminates staff input, restricts pedagogical creativity, and damages institutional morale.

questions.question_english: In educational administration and student counseling, a 'Sociogram' is primarily utilized to assess:
options_english: The annual budgetary allocations and financial distribution of institutional funds across departments
The chronological timeline and pacing schedule for covering the prescribed academic curriculum
The informal social dynamics, interpersonal networks, and peer relationships within a group
The formal administrative hierarchy and chain of command within the educational institution
questions.explanation_english:
A sociogram, developed by Jacob L. Moreno in the field of sociometry, is a visual and graphic representation used in educational psychology and organizational management to map interpersonal relationships, informal communication networks, and social dynamics within a group. By charting individual social preferences, peer acceptance, cliques, and patterns of isolation, school administrators, principals, and counselors gain vital insights into group cohesion, informal peer leadership, and the overarching socio-emotional climate of the learning environment.
- Option A is incorrect because the allocation and financial distribution of school funds across departments is managed through budgetary charts, fiscal accounting ledgers, and cash-flow statements.
- Option B is incorrect because curriculum pacing schedules and chronological syllabus coverage are tracked using academic calendars, syllabus breakdowns, and Gantt charts.
- Option D is incorrect because the formal chain of command and administrative hierarchy of an educational organization is depicted using an organizational chart (organogram).
questions.explanation_hindi:
समाजमिति (सोशियोमेट्री) के जनक जैकब एल. मोरेनो द्वारा विकसित 'समाजचित्र' (सोशोग्राम) एक चित्रात्मक निरूपण उपकरण है, जिसका उपयोग शैक्षणिक मनोविज्ञान और प्रबंधन में किसी समूह के भीतर पारस्परिक संबंधों, अनौपचारिक सामाजिक नेटवर्कों तथा सहकर्मी अंतःक्रियाओं का विश्लेषण करने के लिए किया जाता है। छात्रों या समूह के सदस्यों की पसंद, अस्वीकृति, गुटों और अलगाव के प्रतिरूपों को रेखांकित करके, प्रधानाचार्य या परामर्शदाता समूह की एकजुटता, अनौपचारिक नेतृत्व और विद्यालय के सामाजिक-भावनात्मक वातावरण की गहरी समझ प्राप्त करते हैं।
